title: Non-arithmetic clauses of canonical Tate arrow naturality
statement: Under the finite-field, coefficient, and separated finite-type model hypotheses of lem-pur-canonical-tate-arrow-naturality, the two geometric all-stage laws, the two coefficient laws, and the two strict coefficient laws hold for the geometric Frobenius square. The final parity identities are omitted.

source.place: Canonical Tate naturality composite, Steps 1–8; the parity calculation is separated as an elementary final step.

proof.text: Establish the finite, integral, rational, common-stage, strict-system and root-tower identities by the canonical roots-of-unity comparison, coefficient balancing, tensor-power additivity, completed-operation tower substitution, rationalization and mixed-identity calculations described in the parent node. These are precisely the six clauses in the Lean target; no parity assertion is used.

proof_origin.place: Canonical Tate naturality composite, Steps 1–8. E9: record the relocated predicate and ordinary/scalar comparison definition nodes; the core statement, Lean attachment and original hole are unchanged.

theorem geometricTateCore (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of D.k₀)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom] [IsSeparated Y₀.hom]
    (w₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) :
    geometricTateCoreProp l E D hl Ω X₀ Y₀ w₀
